verification.method: Direct visual inspection of generated PNG and separately of the final WebP using view_image; authored observations, not automatic prompt paraphrase.
verification.scope: Visible depicted setting, geometry, objects, state and approximate regions; not engineering certification or integrated UI acceptance.

coordinateSystem.precision: approximate visual bounds; not exact hotspot anchors

cacheRule: These observations are valid only while the exact final asset SHA-256 matches. Any byte change invalidates this VERIFIED record and requires renewed pixel inspection. The prompt describes intention and cannot substitute for verified observations.

generation.strategy: one new image in one tool call per asset; no reference image or user screenshot
generation.assetPreparation: Copy generated PNG; ordinary format conversion only using Pillow WebP quality=92, method=6; no crop, compositing, repainting or Python image editing.

panel.integratedUIQA: not performed in this isolated asset task

sourceRelation.confirmedMismatch: Previous image is inside an orbital corridor while travel arrives before the ascent craft has docked.
sourceRelation.integrationRule: Reference additive exterior asset only from the corrected successor; leave previous M18.webp and archived source versions unchanged. This does not change docking graph semantics.

depicted.setting: Exterior orbital space beside a receiving spacecraft over Mars
depicted.scale: Close orbital vehicle encounter, receiving collar fills roughly two-thirds of image width; planet below is distant.
depicted.viewpoint: Outside and ahead of the receiving module, facing its closed circular hatch; the cylindrical body recedes toward upper right. No camera spacecraft, cockpit or window frame is visible.
depicted.state: Waiting receiving module alone; closed hatch and unobstructed docking collar; no attached arriving craft.
depicted.colorAndLight: Deep navy/black open space, orange-red planetary terrain, off-white sunlit hull, blue-grey shadows and amber collar lights; full color with no washout.

features.name: Open orbital space
features.visibility: Clear upper field with sparse stars and subtle upper-left glow; no interior enclosure.

features.name: Curved Mars surface and limb
features.visibility: Rust-orange terrain sweeps diagonally down-right with a thin blue rim; partly occluded by orbital module and solar panels.

features.name: Receiving orbital module exterior
features.visibility: Near side and closed front docking assembly clearly visible, rear recedes upward/right, outer right side cropped by frame.

features.name: Round docking collar and closed inner hatch
features.visibility: Complete dark circular collar rim with closed pale segmented hatch, clearly visible; four amber lights at its cardinal sides. No second vessel contacts it.

features.name: Solar arrays
features.visibility: Dark-blue panel wing extends left from behind module and is cropped at left frame; additional panel sections partly cropped at right.

features.name: Outer handrail and antenna fixtures
features.visibility: Gold-toned rail above collar; slim antenna and small dish on the rear module. Fixed hull fixtures, not floating tools.

explicitNegatives: No interior floor, ceiling or corridor.
No visible cockpit or camera-craft window frame.
No arriving/player craft painted as already docked.
No people, astronauts, loose cargo or floating inventory.
No legible text, UI, title, label, logo or border.
unresolvedAmbiguities: Exact scale and engineering correctness of this fictional collar are not independently validated.
Precise final hotspot-to-feature alignment and tile occlusion need the parent integrated 390x844 UI check; feature bounds are not instructions to redesign hotspots.
The exterior receiving-module artwork does not by itself resolve whether later story beats require an interior panel.
disposition: Accepted as art-only correction for pre-docking exterior rendezvous, subject to parent successor integration and UI review.
